content_sections.heading: How to Apply & Walk-in for Bhilai Steel Plant Apprentice Recruitment
content_sections.text: Register as a candidate on apprenticeshipindia.org . Log in and go to Apprenticeship Opportunity → search by Establishment Name " SAIL BHILAI STEEL PLANT ". Apply against the prescribed trade appearing on the portal. Applications not registered/applied on the portal will not be accepted. Register as a student on nats.education.gov.in (NATS). Log in and go to Establishment Requests → Find Establishments → select Steel Authority of India Limited, Bhilai Steel Plant . Apply in your passed-out branch of engineering/discipline appearing on the portal. After successfully applying, walk in as per the schedule for your trade/branch above. Candidates must have an active e-mail ID and mobile number valid for at least the next one year; all future communication is only through e-mail The bank account must be DBT-enabled with KYC verified Ensure correctness of all information before final submission; the candidate is wholly responsible for the details provided Take a printout of the filled-in online application for future reference Important: Apply on the respective portal by 20 October 2026 . Marks in the qualifying exam must be entered as a percentage; CGPA must be converted per the board/university's norms and may be verified at document verification. Incomplete/erroneous applications after the last date will be rejected, with no further correspondence.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (At Time of Walk-in)
content_sections.text: Self-attested copy of Matriculation certificate (for date of birth verification) Self-attested copy of Provisional Pass Certificate Self-attested copy of SC/ST/OBC/PH certificate, if applicable Self-attested copy of Aadhaar Card/Passbook (e-KYC validation mandatory) Medical Fitness Certificate from a Government Hospital Apprentice Registration copy from the NAPS/NATS portal

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Vacancies displayed are indicative and may be changed at any time BSP will not provide accommodation during training; apprentices must make their own arrangements, and BSP is not liable for any Travel Allowance Engagement is subject to being declared medically fit as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 requirement; the medical certificate must be from a Government doctor and bear the doctor's medical registration number Management reserves the right to cancel the selection process at any point; its decision on selection is final BSP has no obligation to offer regular employment to apprentices during or after the training period Canvassing of any kind will disqualify a candidate The date and venue of joining for selected candidates will be intimated only through e-mail

faq.question: Q1. How many apprentice vacancies are notified by Bhilai Steel Plant?
faq.answer: 710 vacancies in total – 516 Trade Apprentice (ITI) posts and 194 Graduate/Diploma Apprentice posts (124 Diploma + 70 Degree).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply on the respective portal (Apprenticeship India for ITI, NATS for Graduate/Diploma) by 20 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No, there is no written test. Selection is merit-based (30% Class-X marks + 70% qualifying-exam marks) through a walk-in process.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: 18 to 28 years as on 31 October 2026, with reservation-based age relaxation per Chhattisgarh Government guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: ₹9,600/month for ITI Trade Apprentices, ₹10,900/month for Diploma Apprentices, and ₹12,300/month for Graduate Apprentices, or as per MSDE-prescribed rates.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the walk-in held?
faq.answer: At Room No. 123, HRDC, Bhilai Steel Plant, Chhattisgarh 490001, on a trade-wise schedule between 27 October and 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates who passed outside 2022–2026, those with results still awaited, and those with a year or more of prior apprenticeship/job experience.

faq.question: Q8. Does this apprenticeship guarantee a job at SAIL?
faq.answer: No. BSP has no obligation to offer regular employment during or after the apprenticeship training period.
